certification.name: CREST Practitioner Intrusion Analyst
certification.description: Entry-level closed-book exam of 120 multiple-choice questions in two hours on incident handling, network and host intrusion analysis and high-level malware analysis, pass mark 60%. A valid CPIA is required before sitting the CRIA.
